source_documents.title: Enhancement of the Excited-state Intramolecular Proton Transfer Process to Produce All-powerful DSE Molecules for Bridging the Gap Between ACQ and AIE

conditions_studied: benzene, THF, DMF, DMSO, MeCN, acetone, chloroform, methanol

reference_evidence_units.quote: were designed by a strategy in which the excited-state intramolecular proton transfer (ESIPT)
reference_evidence_units.subject: ITP series
reference_evidence_units.statement: ESIPT enhanced to restrict the TICT nonradiative channel.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the TICT for nonradiative de-excitation and finely controlling their self-assembly.
reference_evidence_units.subject: ITP series
reference_evidence_units.statement: DSE from ESIPT-suppressed TICT plus controlled self-assembly.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Even in methanol, ITP1 exhibits clear enol/keto PL efficiency with ΦF
reference_evidence_units.subject: ITP1
reference_evidence_units.statement: Separate enol (395 nm) and keto (525 nm) emission.

reference_evidence_units.quote: 35 due to the enhancement of ESIPTthat restricts the TICT.
reference_evidence_units.subject: ITP1 vs DF1
reference_evidence_units.statement: kr nearly unchanged while knr falls ~35-fold vs DF1; assigned to ESIPT suppressing TICT.

reference_evidence_units.quote: but the knr of ITP1 was about three times that of DF1
reference_evidence_units.subject: ITP1 vs DF1
reference_evidence_units.statement: Solid-state knr of ITP1 is three times higher with similar kr.

reference_evidence_units.quote: bonding interactions restricting the rotation of ring D
reference_evidence_units.subject: ITP1, DF1
reference_evidence_units.statement: Intramolecular H-bonding restricts rotation of ring D, a key factor for efficiency.

reference_evidence_units.quote: consisted of equivalent of two different imidazole isomers (3H-imi and 1H-imi) in one single
reference_evidence_units.subject: ITP1
reference_evidence_units.statement: Heterogeneous packing with strong π-π contacts (3.4-3.9 Å).

reference_evidence_units.quote: aggregate packing in photoluminogens readily decrease their PL efficiency
reference_evidence_units.subject: ITP1 (and design of the series)
reference_evidence_units.statement: Strong π-π / H-aggregate packing lowers ITP1 solid efficiency.
